analysis.title_zh: LangSmith 新动态：Engine v2、Managed Deep Agents、Fine-Tuning 等
analysis.summary: 【官方公告】LangSmith Engine v2 引入红队测试、扩展问题检测和自动修复验证；Managed Deep Agents 支持身份范围限定的授权，并新增用户级记忆与内置网页搜索。Trajectories 提供追踪记录的对话视图，LangSmith Fine-Tuning 利用这些轨迹微调模型，适配专门任务。Custom Apps 支持构建并发布自定义界面，用于标注队列和实验等工作流。所给节选未提供效果量化数据。
analysis.application: 建议：【科研迁移建议】可探索用问题检测与修复验证辅助智能运维代理测试，用会话轨迹整理领域微调数据，并为可靠性实验设计标注界面；这些属于迁移设想，不是官方已验证的科研效果。【官方已验证效果】所给公告仅陈述功能与用途，未提供性能对比、实验结果或科研场景验证。
evidence: LangSmith Engine v2 introduces red teaming, expanded issue detection, and automated fix validation.
Run agents with identity-scoped auth and memory. Managed Deep Agents makes it simple build and ship agents, and now includes user-level memory and built-in web search.
Trajectories is a new conversational view of traces.
LangSmith Fine-Tuning turns uses trajectories to tune models for specialized tasks.
With Custom Apps, teams can build and publish custom LangSmith interfaces for workflows like annotation queues and experiments.
